title: Port susi-vendor-wasmer to wasmtime for a compliant Windows backend
goal: wasmer 7.4.2 has no usable native backend on Windows: wasmer-compiler-singlepass and wasmer-compiler-cranelift both carry compile_error!() under cfg(windows), singlepass is BUSL-1.1 (the reason Windows release builds are unpublished per .github/workflows/dev-release.yml), and the v8 backend exposes no CompilerConfig middleware so CELL_FUEL metering would be silently dropped. Port the vendored wasm runtime (susi-vendor-wasmer renamed susi-vendor-wasmtime, since a vendor crate must own and honestly name its external dependency) to wasmtime + wasmtime-wasi: fuel via Config::consume_fuel + Store::set_fuel preserving CELL_FUEL semantics, the declared-max memory cap rewrite kept via wasmparser/wasm-encoder, host_send under both env and susi namespaces via Linker with Caller-scoped HostState, and the WASI reflex runner via wasmtime-wasi preview1 with piped stdout and no preopened directories. Wasmtime is Apache-2.0 with first-class windows-msvc support, so this removes the last build-time reason susi cannot compile on Windows. Bootstrap note: the susi binary cannot build on Windows until this lands, so the claim ref was created by hand (refs/claims/T-DEVIN20261018WASMTIME-1) because `susi tasks` cannot run on a Windows host yet.
